# SPECIFICATION: REWARDS EARNING RULES DISPLAY

## CURRENT STATE SUMMARY:
Today, customers earn rewards based on accelerated, standard, or exclusion rules configured in the system, but the earning logic is not displayed to users at transaction time. Operations teams monitor rewards accrual through reconciliation reports, and customer support handles queries about why specific cashback rates were applied. Users only see final reward points earned without understanding which rule (accelerated vs standard) was triggered or if they hit any caps.

---

## SCOPE:

### IN SCOPE:
- Display earning rule type (accelerated/standard/exclusion) on transaction detail screen
- Show applicable cashback rate percentage for each transaction
- Display remaining cap balance for accelerated rewards categories
- Show merchant category that triggered specific earning rule
- Provide rule explanation text for each transaction type
- Display exclusion reason when no rewards earned

### OUT OF SCOPE:
- Predictive rewards calculator for future transactions — requires complex merchant mapping not yet available in system
- Historical rule change tracking beyond current statement cycle — data retention policy limits historical rule metadata storage
- Personalized rule recommendations based on spending patterns — requires ML capability not in current roadmap
- Real-time rule change notifications during transaction — presentment timing makes pre-transaction alerts infeasible
- Gamification or progress bars for reward milestones — separate feature planned for Q3 2026

---

## FUNCTIONAL USE CASES:

### Use Case 1: View Accelerated Reward Rule Details (Happy Path)
**Actor:** Primary cardholder

**Precondition:** User has completed a transaction at an accelerated rewards merchant, transaction has reached presentment stage, and rewards have been accrued to account

**User Story:** As a Pixel cardholder, I want to see why I earned 5% cashback instead of 1% on my Swiggy transaction so that I understand my accelerated rewards benefit and can optimize future spending

**Steps:**
1. User navigates to transaction history on PIXEL app home screen
2. User taps on specific Swiggy transaction showing "150 reward points earned"
3. System displays transaction detail screen with rewards earning breakdown section
4. User views "Accelerated Rewards: 5% on Food Delivery" label with merchant category icon
5. User sees "Cap remaining: ₹450 of ₹500 monthly limit" progress indicator
6. User taps "Learn more" link to view full accelerated rewards T&C

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Given user views transaction with accelerated rewards, when transaction detail loads, then rewards section displays "Accelerated Rewards" badge with percentage rate and merchant category name
- Given accelerated reward has monthly cap, when rewards section renders, then remaining cap amount displays as "₹X of ₹Y remaining this month" with progress bar showing utilization percentage
- Given transaction earned standard rewards after cap exhaustion, when user views subsequent transaction at same merchant, then system displays "Standard Rewards: 1% (Accelerated limit reached)" with reset date
- Given multiple reward rules could apply, when system determines applicable rule, then highest value rule is applied and displayed with "Best rate applied" indicator
- Given user taps merchant category name, when category detail opens, then system shows all merchants in that accelerated category with scrollable list

**Failure State AC:**
- Given rewards calculation is pending, when user views transaction within 2 hours of presentment, then system displays "Rewards processing" status with expected completion time
- Given rewards data fails to load, when API timeout occurs after 5 seconds, then system shows transaction amount with "Rewards details unavailable" message and retry button
- Given transaction is at excluded merchant, when user views detail, then system displays "No rewards earned: Excluded category (Fuel)" with link to full exclusion list

**Priority:** P0

---

### Use Case 2: View Rewards After Partial Cap Utilization (Edge Case)
**Actor:** Primary cardholder

**Precondition:** User has partially exhausted accelerated rewards cap (e.g., ₹480 of ₹500 used), and makes transaction that would exceed remaining cap if fully accelerated

**User Story:** As a Pixel cardholder, I want to understand why my ₹50 transaction earned mixed rewards rates so that I can track my cap utilization accurately

**Steps:**
1. User completes ₹50 transaction at accelerated merchant with ₹20 cap remaining
2. System applies accelerated rate to ₹20 (earning 10 points) and standard rate to ₹30 (earning 3 points)
3. User opens transaction detail screen
4. System displays split rewards calculation: "13 points earned (10 accelerated + 3 standard)"
5. User views "Accelerated cap exhausted on [date]" message with reset date
6. User sees breakdown: "₹20 @ 5% + ₹30 @ 1%"

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Given transaction amount exceeds remaining accelerated cap, when rewards are calculated, then system applies accelerated rate to remaining cap amount and standard rate to overflow amount
- Given split rate calculation occurs, when user views transaction detail, then rewards section shows itemized breakdown with two line items: "[Amount] @ [Accelerated %]" and "[Amount] @ [Standard %]"
- Given accelerated cap is fully exhausted mid-transaction, when detail screen loads, then system displays "Cap limit reached" banner with next reset date in DD-MMM-YYYY format
- Given cap resets on statement date, when user views exhausted cap message, then countdown shows "Resets in X days" if within 7 days of reset

**Failure State AC:**
- Given cap calculation has data inconsistency, when system detects mismatch between transaction total and split amounts, then system applies standard rate to full transaction and logs error for ops review with transaction ID

**Priority:** P1

---

### Use Case 3: View Exclusion Rule for Zero Rewards Transaction (Failure)
**Actor:** Primary cardholder

**Precondition:** User completes transaction at excluded merchant category (fuel, wallet load, rent payment), transaction reaches presentment, and zero rewards are accrued

**User Story:** As a Pixel cardholder, I want to know why I earned no rewards on my fuel purchase so that I understand exclusion rules and don't expect rewards incorrectly

**Steps:**
1. User completes ₹2000 fuel transaction at Shell petrol pump
2. Transaction appears in transaction history with "0 reward points earned"
3. User taps transaction to view details
4. System displays rewards section with "No rewards earned" status
5. User views exclusion reason: "Fuel purchases excluded from rewards program"
6. User taps "View all exclusions" link to see complete excluded category list

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Given transaction is at excluded merchant, when transaction detail loads, then rewards section displays "No rewards earned" with red info icon and exclusion category name
- Given exclusion applies, when user views reason, then system shows specific exclusion type from list: "Fuel", "Wallet loads", "Rent payments", "Utility bills", "EMI transactions", "Cash advances"
- Given user wants more information, when user taps "View all exclusions" link, then system opens bottom sheet with complete exclusion list grouped by category with merchant examples
- Given merchant is misclassified, when user taps "Report incorrect category" button, then system opens support ticket with pre-filled transaction details and merchant information

**Failure State AC:**
- Given exclusion rule data is unavailable, when API fails to return exclusion reason, then system displays "No rewards earned" without specific reason and shows generic "Some categories excluded" message with support contact option
- Given merchant category is unmapped, when system cannot determine if exclusion applies, then system defaults to standard rewards rate and logs merchant for ops team review with MID and merchant name

**Priority:** P1

---

## NON-FUNCTIONAL USE CASES:

### Performance:
- **Rewards rule data load time:** Transaction detail screen with rewards breakdown must load within 2 seconds on 4G network connection
  - **Acceptance:** 95th percentile load time ≤2 seconds measured via Firebase Performance Monitoring for zchs_transaction_detail_viewed event

- **Cap calculation accuracy:** Remaining cap balance must reflect all transactions processed up to last presentment cycle with zero calculation errors
  - **Acceptance:** Daily reconciliation report shows 100% match between displayed cap utilization and actual accrued rewards in statement cycle

### Security:
- **Rewards rule configuration access:** Only authorized ops team members with "REWARDS_CONFIG_ADMIN" role can modify earning rules, caps, or exclusion lists
  - **Acceptance:** Audit log captures all rule changes with user ID, timestamp, old value, new value, and approval ticket number; unauthorized access attempts trigger security alert

### Accessibility:
- **Screen reader support:** All rewards earning rule elements must be accessible via TalkBack (Android) and VoiceOver (iOS) with descriptive labels
  - **Acceptance:** Rewards section announces "Accelerated rewards, 5 percent on food delivery, cap remaining 450 rupees of 500 rupees" when focused; progress bar announces percentage utilization

- **Color contrast compliance:** Rewards rate badges, cap indicators, and exclusion messages must meet WCAG 2.1 AA standards (4.5:1 contrast ratio)
  - **Acceptance:** Automated accessibility scan shows zero contrast violations in rewards display components; manual testing confirms readability in bright sunlight conditions

### Reliability:
- **Graceful degradation:** If rewards rule service is unavailable, transaction details must still display with basic rewards points earned without rule breakdown
  - **Acceptance:** When rewards-rule-service returns 5xx error or times out after 5 seconds, app displays "X points earned" with "Details unavailable" message and does not block transaction view; error logged to Sentry with transaction ID

- **Data consistency:** Rewards rule displayed must match actual rule applied during transaction presentment with zero discrepancies
  - **Acceptance:** Weekly audit compares rule_type field in transaction_rewards table against displayed rule in app logs; discrepancy rate <0.1% triggers ops investigation

---

## METRICS IMPACT:

### Metric 1: Customer Support Tickets - Rewards Queries
- **Current baseline:** Unknown — check with analytics (estimated 15-20% of total support volume based on CS team feedback)
- **Expected impact:** 40% reduction in rewards-related support tickets within 60 days of launch
- **Owner:** Customer Support Operations team

### Metric 2: Rewards Redemption Rate
- **Current baseline:** Unknown — check with analytics (request from Rewards Product team)
- **Expected impact:** 15% increase in monthly redemption rate as users gain confidence in understanding earning mechanics
- **Owner:** Rewards Product team

### Metric 3: Transaction Detail Screen Engagement
- **Current baseline:** Unknown — check with analytics (need zchs_transaction_detail_viewed event baseline)
- **Expected impact:** 25% increase in transaction detail views as users actively check earning rules
- **Owner:** Product Analytics team

---

## NEW METRICS TO TRACK:

### Metric 1: Rewards Rule View Rate
- **Definition:** Percentage of transactions where user views transaction detail screen with rewards breakdown within 48 hours of transaction presentment
- **Target:** 35% of all reward-earning transactions viewed within 48 hours by end of Q2 2026
- **Owner:** Product Analytics team

### Metric 2: Accelerated Cap Awareness Rate
- **Definition:** Percentage of users who view transaction details after exhausting 80% of any accelerated rewards cap in a statement cycle
- **Target:** 50% of users hitting 80% cap threshold view at least one transaction detail showing cap status
- **Owner:** Rewards Product team

### Metric 3: Exclusion Rule Discovery Rate
- **Definition:** Number of users who view "View all exclusions" link divided by number of users with at least one excluded transaction in statement cycle
- **Target:** 20% of users with excluded transactions access full exclusion list within first statement cycle
- **Owner:** Product Analytics team

### Metric 4: Rewards Rule API Error Rate
- **Definition:** Percentage of transaction detail API calls where rewards rule data fails to load (5xx errors, timeouts >5s, null responses)
- **Target:** <0.5% error rate measured daily; P0 alert if exceeds 2% for 1 hour
- **Owner:** Engineering - Backend team

---

## REPORTS & EXTRACTS IMPACT:

### New Reports Needed:
- **Rewards Rule Display Audit Report:** Daily reconciliation comparing rule_type displayed in app (from instrumentation logs) vs rule_type applied in core banking system (from transaction_rewards table); includes discrepancy count, affected transaction IDs, and merchant details
- **Cap Utilization Accuracy Report:** Weekly report validating displayed "cap remaining" amounts match actual cap consumption in rewards ledger; flags transactions where displayed cap differs from calculated cap by >₹1
- **Exclusion Misclassification Report:** Monthly report of transactions where users clicked "Report incorrect category" button; includes merchant name, MID, MCC code, current category mapping, and user-reported expected category

### Existing Reports Affected:
- **Monthly Rewards Report (Opening balance, earning, burning, elapsed, closing balance):** Add new columns: accelerated_earnings, standard_earnings, exclusion_count, split_rate_transaction_count to break down earning sources
- **Rewards Reconciliation Report:** Add rule_type field to each transaction line item to enable ops team to verify correct rule application during reconciliation
- **Customer Notifications Report:** Add trigger for cap exhaustion notification when user hits 100% of accelerated cap; include next reset date in notification payload

### Reconciliation Requirements:
- **Rewards rule display vs core banking:** Daily reconciliation must confirm rule_type shown in app matches rule_type in Zeta core banking transaction_rewards table with 100% accuracy; discrepancies trigger ops investigation within 4 business hours
- **Cap balance display vs ledger:** Real-time cap balance shown to user must reconcile against sum of accelerated transactions in current statement cycle from rewards_accrual_ledger table; variance >₹5 triggers alert to rewards ops team
- **Exclusion application consistency:** Weekly validation that all transactions at merchants in exclusion_merchant_master table show zero rewards and display exclusion reason; any excluded merchant earning rewards triggers immediate rule configuration audit

### Data Extract Requirements:
- **Analytics team:** Daily extract of rewards_rule_viewed events with transaction_id, rule_type, cap_remaining_amount, user_id, timestamp for funnel analysis and engagement tracking
- **Business Intelligence team:** Monthly extract of rewards earning breakdown by rule type (accelerated vs standard vs excluded) with GMV, transaction count, and reward points issued for P&L reporting
- **Customer Support team:** Real-time access to transaction-level rule application data via internal support dashboard; must include rule_type, merchant_category, cap_status, exclusion_reason for ticket resolution

---

## INSTRUMENTATION REQUIREMENTS:

### Event 1: zchs_rewards_rule_viewed
- **Trigger:** When transaction detail screen loads and rewards earning breakdown section renders successfully with rule information
- **Properties:**
  - transaction_id (String): Unique transaction identifier
  - rule_type (String): "accelerated", "standard", "exclusion", "split_rate"
  - reward_rate (String): Percentage rate applied (e.g., "5%", "1%", "0%")
  - merchant_category (String): Category name that triggered rule (e.g., "Food Delivery", "Fuel")
  - cap_remaining_amount (Number): Remaining cap balance in rupees for accelerated categories, null if not applicable
  - cap_utilization_percent (Number): Percentage of cap used (0-100), null if not applicable
  - time_since_transaction (Number): Hours elapsed between transaction presentment and detail view
- **Purpose:** Measure user engagement with rewards transparency feature and identify which rule types drive most interest; inform cap threshold optimization

### Event 2: zchs_rewards_rule_interaction
- **Trigger:** When user taps any interactive element within rewards earning breakdown section
- **Properties:**
  - transaction_id (String): Unique transaction identifier
  - interaction (String): "learn_more_tapped", "view_all_exclusions_tapped", "report_incorrect_category_tapped", "merchant_category_tapped"
  - rule_type (String): "accelerated", "standard", "exclusion", "split_rate"
  - merchant_category (String): Category associated with interaction
- **Purpose:** Identify which rewards rule explanations require more clarity based on help-seeking behavior; prioritize content improvements

### Event 3: zchs_rewards_rule_load_failure
- **Trigger:** When rewards rule data fails to load on transaction detail screen due to API error, timeout, or null response
- **Properties:**
  - transaction_id (String): Unique transaction identifier
  - error_code (String): HTTP status code or internal error code
  - error_message (String): Error description from API response
  - fallback_displayed (Boolean): Whether basic rewards points shown without rule breakdown
  - retry_attempted (Boolean): Whether user tapped retry button
- **Purpose:** Monitor reliability of rewards rule service and identify patterns in failures; trigger engineering investigation if error rate exceeds
